caveats: delta-K is one shared 24x24 operator built from two independently trained models (pre_model, post_model); it has no subject dimension, so a literal same-subject delta-C x delta-K test is not computable.
Operator-level uncertainty of delta-K (run-to-run optimisation noise, two training runs) is NOT represented in any p-value here.
The subject-level family treats 19 held-out folds of delta-C against a fixed predictor; a nonzero mean rho therefore reflects region ordering agreement, not subject-specific coupling.
All results are hypothesis-generating and must be reported with effect sizes and CIs, consistent with the main report's N=19 power boundary.
